query: Which complementary ecological indicators (catch per unit effort, biomass proxies, species richness) will be secondary outcomes, and what multiple-testing rules and reporting hierarchy will we preregister?

response.query: Which complementary ecological indicators (catch per unit effort, biomass proxies, species richness) will be secondary outcomes, and what multiple-testing rules and reporting hierarchy will we preregister?
response.answer: Secondary outcomes include catch per unit effort, biomass proxies, and species richness. Preregister multiple-testing rules and reporting hierarchy will follow Holm-Bonferroni correction and primary outcome hierarchy.
